time.where: Where: Sports hall of LAB University of Applied Sciences

main.main_1: Haalarilanit is a big LAN-gaming event that has been held at the LAB University's gymnasium in Lappeenranta.
main.main_2: The most epic gaming event of autumn will start when almost 200 gamers gather to enjoy the joy of gaming together. If you are a passionate eSport gamer or a casual weekend gaming enjoyer, there is definitely enough gamers to play with.
main.main_3: Different gaming tournaments are held during the event where best of the best compete for the first place in different games like Counter Strike 2 or NHL. This will be your chance show what you are made of while competing agains your friends and foes.

main_4.text: Bring your own Computer, connect it to the LAN and you are ready to experience the captivating world of LAN-parties. At the event there is a stand where you can buy drinks and something to eat during your gaming moments

main_5.text: The event area is alcohol free zone so all alcoholic drinks are prohibited to bring inside. You don't need previous experience from a LAN-party event to attend and feel free to ask about this event from our

photos.text: Link is under this text. Photos have been taken from the event area.

dont_bring.header: You cannot bring these things to the event area
dont_bring.category_1: Items that can hurt other people (knifes etc)

substances.point_1: Usage and posession of alcohol or other intoxicants is prohibited in the event area. You must leave all alcoholic bewerages and other intoxicants outside of the event area.
substances.point_2: Smoking and vaping is allowed only at the places marked as smoking zones. Trash cans for cigarette butts can be found at the smoking places and must be used.

power.point_1: Connecting household appliances and other high-power electrical devices to your electrical outlet is strictly prohibited. Each gamer gets one electrical outlet  which is sufficient for 350W of power.
power.point_2: At the event there is a microwave and electric kettle for everyone to use. If your computer needs more then 350W of power, please contact the organizers before the event.

damages.text: Damaging and messing up the event area strictly prohibited. For example usage of stickers on walls. If you damage something you are always liable for compensation.

network.beginning: You cannot do these things on the events network:
network.category_3: Monitoring traffic other than traffic from your own computer
network.category_4: Connecting additional devices, such as switches or firewalls
network.category_5: Retrieving or distributing copurighted material or material that violates Finnish law

sleep.text: For safety reasons sleeping is only allowed at your own seat. Sleeping on the floor or in other places on the event area is prohibited.

other.point_1: Every Finnish law must be followed during the event
other.point_2: Organizers are not liable for any broken computers or other devices
other.point_3: Organizers have the right to remove a person from the event area. No refund of the ticket will be provided in the case of removal. On special occasions a person can be removed immediately from the event area.
other.point_4: The perpetrator is always responsible for any damage caused and its compensation.

guidance.paragraph_1: Entrance to the event is open for 24h a day and it is located near the LAB-University's parking lot. Entrance and doors to toilets are marked on the event map above.
guidance.paragraph_2: During the event the LAB parking lot is free and there will be no parking control. Entrance is barrier-free.

tournaments.text: 2026 Tournaments and their times will be posted later.
tournaments.description: Semi-formal tournaments are arranged at Haalarilanit. The entrance to the event is free and you may come spectate and express your support on the spot.

equipment.descriptor: Bring all your needed gaming gear but be mindful of the restrictions of your seat

event_end.message: The event has ended. See you next year!
